sentences.en: The gold coin was much more valuable than was supposed.
sentences.zh: 这枚金币比人们想象中的更有价值。

sentences.en: A man of straw is worth a woman of gold.
sentences.zh: 滥竽充数的人顶不上真正的金子。

sentences.en: It seems as if everything he touches turns to gold.
sentences.zh: 他所触及的一切似乎都变成了黄金。
